explanation: erdosproblems.com/448: Hall and Tenenbaum prove that τ⁺(n)/τ(n) has a distribution function. The Lean statement gives a monotone F : ℝ → ℝ with limits 0 at −∞ and 1 at +∞ such that at every continuity point z, {n : τ⁺(n)/τ(n) ≤ z} has natural density F(z) — the standard definition of a limiting distribution function for an arithmetic function. Faithful.
